About the Scholarship

FilmMemory trains film curators, archivists and memory scholars across a Belgian-led consortium with strong links to cinematheques and archives. The consortium publishes each year's call on its Call for Applicants page, where the closing date and scholarship information are posted.

Study LevelMaster's

StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

FilmMemory trains film curators, archivists and memory scholars across a Belgian-led consortium with strong links to cinematheques and archives. The consortium publishes each year's call on its Call for Applicants page, where the closing date and scholarship information are posted.

Programme Highlights

  • Film heritage and memory studies with hands-on curatorial training
  • Partnerships with film archives and cinematheques across Europe
  • Call-for-applicants page carries the current deadline each cycle
  • Graduates work in film archives, festivals, museums and academic research

Who Should Apply

Film studies, history, cultural studies and media graduates with an archival or curatorial interest; writing samples often matter in the selection.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the Call for Applicants page on the FilmMemory site and follow the document checklist for the live cycle. Key deadline information: Annual round — current call and closing date published on the Call for Applicants page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About FilmMemory Consortium

The FilmMemory consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Film and Memory with Belgian coordination and European film-heritage partners.

Official website: https://filmmemory.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual round - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
